title: Guide to the complete system coding table
table_unit: One included modeled system per row; a system can have several bibliographic records.
branch_applicability: Each column can apply to virtual models and self-described digital twins. Conditional applicability depends on the model family or feature, rather than which branch supplied the record.
reading_notes: Column names are the exact workbook headers. This file describes columns and values; it does not list the underlying papers or their individual coding records.
Semicolons separate multiple labels in fields marked multi_select. Do not sum multiple selections as if they were different systems.
Conventional missing-value terms within multiselect text have the same meaning regardless of capitalization.
A modeled scale requires its own computed biological states; an input, a named scale, or an evaluation endpoint does not establish that scale as modeled.
Final individualization, completed research loops, evidence, and credibility are separate concepts. A self-described digital twin is not automatically a completed feedback loop.

For credibility indicators, unqualified yes means documented support; qualified yes values retain their narrower meanings. An inclusive count can include qualified yes values, whereas a documented count includes only unqualified yes.
Not applicable in a numbered interface or omission column can mean an unused slot. It does not mean the entire system is irrelevant.
Not recorded is a table-completeness statement, not a conclusion about what the paper reports.
All fields can apply to both survey branches. The conditional rules identify the applicable model family or feature where needed.

shared_value_meanings.no: A negative coding decision for the stated criterion in the material assessed. It is not a missing value.
shared_value_meanings.Not reported: The article does not provide the information needed for this field. This does not mean no.
shared_value_meanings.Not applicable: The question does not apply in this case, or this numbered list slot is unused. The column description identifies which meaning applies.
shared_value_meanings.Not recorded: No value or detail was entered in this table for this field. Do not infer that the article lacks the information.
shared_value_meanings.None recorded: No first-release ordering caveat was entered. This is used only in the first-channel uncertainty note.
shared_value_meanings.none: An explicitly empty set or absent item under the definition of this particular field; consult its description.

columns.label: System id
columns.description: Stable survey identifier for one modeled system. One row represents a system, not necessarily one paper.
columns.branch_notes: S and DS are survey roster prefixes. They are identifiers, not tests of individualization or a completed feedback loop.

columns.label: Branch
columns.description: The survey branch from which the system was included. Branch membership describes naming and screening scope, not whether a completed digital-twin feedback loop is demonstrated.

values.meaning: The system belongs to the branch whose own authors use a twin designation; it need not meet the survey criteria for a completed feedback loop.

columns.label: First recorded date

columns.label: First date lower

columns.label: First date upper

columns.label: First-publication ordering caveat
